We’ve had a rest day, so we’ve recharged our batteries. It’s a stage I know very well; my brother and I have come here to train loads of times in this area. I’m very fond of this stage. My home, my village, is just over an hour away from here. So we’re hoping to see lots of people at the start, along the route and at the finish.
